notes: Mature photos come out the way the moment reads. When a description was vague about who was in it, FLUX played it safe and painted a tame shot — mature prompts now anchor the subject as an explicitly adult woman (characters state their adult age in their own descriptions too), which is both the guardrail and the fix: NSFW LoRAs are trained on adult-stated captions and barely engage without one. The troubleshooting log also now records the exact prompt text and trigger words sent to your GPU, so a tame result can be traced instead of guessed at.
